Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libpsl && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzz/libpsl_icu_load_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":52,"var":"data,size","code":"fp = fmemopen((void *)data, size, \"r\"); psl = psl_load_fp(fp);","note":"The fuzzer feeds attacker-controlled bytes directly into the PSL loader."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"psl_load_fp","line":1184,"var":"buf/linep","code":"if (!(linep = fgets(buf, sizeof(buf) - 1, fp))) goto fail;","note":"The first line is copied into a fixed stack buffer and used to classify the input format."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"psl_load_fp","line":1190,"var":"is_dafsa","code":"is_dafsa = strlen(buf) == 16 && !strncmp(buf, \".DAFSA@PSL_\", 11);","note":"The loader branches on the attacker-controlled header to choose the DAFSA or text parsing path."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"psl_load_fp","line":1200,"var":"idna","code":"idna = psl_idna_open();","note":"For text PSL input, the loader opens an IDNA context before processing rules."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"psl_load_fp","line":1268,"var":"suffixp","code":"if (suffix_init(&suffix, p, linep - p) == 0) { ... add_punycode_if_needed(idna, psl->suffixes, suffixp); }","note":"Each parsed rule is stored as a suffix entry; non-ASCII labels are forwarded to punycode generation."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"add_punycode_if_needed","line":800,"var":"e->label_buf","code":"if (psl_idna_toASCII(idna, e->label_buf, &lookupname) == 0) {","note":"A non-ASCII label triggers conversion to an ASCII lookup string."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"psl_idna_toASCII","line":788,"var":"lookupname","code":"char lookupname[128];","note":"The libidn-disabled fallback uses a fixed 128-byte stack buffer for punycode output."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"domain_to_punycode","line":586,"var":"outsize","code":"if (outlen + labellen + (e != NULL) + 4 >= outsize) return 1;","note":"The helper only checks the remaining space once before punycode expansion, so the caller must supply a sufficiently large buffer."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"domain_to_punycode","line":597,"var":"labellen","code":"if (punycode_encode(inputlen, input, &labellen, out + outlen)) return 1;","note":"The attacker-controlled UTF-8 label is encoded into the remaining bytes of the fixed stack buffer."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"domain_to_punycode","line":603,"var":"out[outlen++]","code":"if (e) out[outlen++] = '.'; out[outlen] = 0;","note":"The helper then appends a separator and terminator into the same stack buffer, completing the vulnerable write sequence."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
print(p)
